name: grok-bridge
description: Unofficial community bridge between Grok Bots and Cursor agents: watch, read and steer Cursor SDK agents from inside Cursor.

grokBridge.nodePath.description: Path to a Node.js >= 22.13 binary used to run the SDK helper. Empty = auto-detect (PATH, nvm, fnm, volta, Homebrew).

grokBridge.sdkDir.description: Optional override: a folder whose node_modules contains @cursor/sdk. Empty = use the bundled SDK.

grokBridge.cwd.description: Optional override for the agents' working directory. Empty = first workspace folder.

grokBridge.defaultModel.description: Model id used for new prompts.
